     \[

     \[
     \text{Time walking} = \frac{2}{3} \times 6 \, \text{hours} = 4 \, \text{hours}.
     \]

   - The distance Dana runs:
     \[
     \text{Distance running} = \text{Running speed} \times \text{Time running} = 6 \, \text{miles/hour} \times 2 \, \text{hours} = 12 \, \text{miles}.

   - The distance Dana walks:
     \[
     \text{Distance walking} = \text{Walking speed} \times \text{Time walking} = 1.5 \, \text{miles/hour} \times 4 \, \text{hours} = 6 \, \text{miles}.

   - The total distance traveled by Dana is the sum of the distances running and walking:
     \[
     \text{Total distance} = \text{Distance running} + \text{Distance walking} = 12 \, \text{miles} + 6 \, \text{miles} = 18 \, \text{miles}.
     \]

   \]
